entities.summary: Joaquim Nhanganga Tyombe is an Angolan Roman Catholic prelate who is the bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Uije in Angola since 2 February 2021. Before that, from 24 November 2001 until he was appointed bishop, he was a priest of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Lubango in Angola. He was appointed bishop by Pope Francis. He was consecrated bishop at Lubango on 7 March 2021. He was installed at Uíge, Angola on 21 March 2021.
